info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Pay Statements Management API
info.description: The Customer Pay Statements Management API allows businesses to efficiently create and manage pay statements for their customers. By utilizing this API, organizations can aggregate and streamline pay statement data for specific customers identified by their unique customer ID. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions or service providers seeking to automate and enhance their customer billing processes. This API significantly reduces manual input and improves accuracy in financial reporting.

post.summary: Create a Pay Statement for a Customer
post.description: This operation allows you to create a new pay statement for a specific customer identified by their unique customer ID. Providing the necessary payment details will result in the creation of a pay statement record associated with the specified customer.
